side_missions.title: Operation Compass Point
side_missions.description: The Warp Marches are destabilizing, and League supply lines through the region are compromised. Dave is ordered to establish a secure corridor through the shifting lanes — failure means League forces are cut off from critical crystal reserves.

objectives.description: Map all spatial anomalies in the target corridor

side_missions.title: Unidentified Strategic Asset
side_missions.description: League deep-space sensors have detected an object of unknown origin beyond the Warp Marches. Preliminary analysis suggests pre-civilisation technology. Dave's orders: recover the asset for League research. Flux offered coordinates — for a price.

objectives.description: Verify Flux's coordinates and assess the approach
Secure the artifact for League custody

side_missions.title: Crystal Research Initiative
side_missions.description: League scientists have been monitoring the Fairy Collective's crystal resonance research with growing alarm. Dave is sent to either participate as a League observer or shut the experiments down — depending on what he finds.

objectives.description: Assess the Fairy research program's safety protocols
Decide to participate in or terminate the experiments
Manage the consequences of the experiment's outcome

side_missions.title: Strategic Assessment Alpha
side_missions.description: With the endgame approaching, League High Command needs a comprehensive assessment of every faction's military capability, alliance status, and crystal reserves. Dave has the contacts. Time to use them.

objectives.description: Compile intelligence dossiers on all major factions
Identify the primary threats to League interests
